description: hls4ml synthesis points of the compact QCNN1D (v2, 25 rings) on the VU13P

provenance.flow: QKeras 0.9.0 -> hls4ml 1.3.0 (Vitis backend, io_parallel, Latency, RF=1, accum auto) -> Vitis HLS 2026.1.1 -> Vivado 2026.1.1 out-of-context synth + place & route
provenance.notes: Conv1D multiplier_limit patched to scale with ParallelizationFactor (hls4ml 1.3 workaround). Per-layer numbers are post-synthesis (hierarchical report); totals are post-route. 'top/glue' = logic Vivado inlined into the top (ReLU, pooling, sigmoid, input, and the whole Conv1D in 'kkt').
